about.title: Who is Lucas Tavares
about.p1: I'm Necromante96Official: I build tools, sites and game experiences. My mod hit 18.5k views (457 favs, 143 ratings), I shipped community PT-BR translation mods authorized by the devs for Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call (Nexus mods/5) and the Hytale PT-BR pack on CurseForge: and I'm translating Dragon Quest I & II Remake and Elementallis as authorized unofficial mods.
about.p2: On the web/systems side, I built FisioHub for the ESEFID/UFRGS clinic (TypeScript + Vite + 3 Chrome Extensions, offline & private) and the Finance Control PWA (offline-first, installable, build 281). Hardcore: Forbidden Legacy Patch Manager (C# .NET 9 + Avalonia, Python + pycryptodome, Godot PCK v4 + GDRE) and Nexus Translator (31 modules, Cursor SDK, Unreal/Unity/Stardew/Hytale, Unity/IL2CPP).
about.p3: I like simple on the surface, solid engineering underneath. Premium minimal design, performance and docs that hold up.

about.philosophy.title: Philosophy
about.philosophy.p1: Simple on the surface, solid underneath. Readable code, docs that answer before you ask, and UI that doesn't fight for attention. I prefer offline, privacy-respecting systems that outlive me: like FisioHub (data never leaves device) and the finance PWA.
about.philosophy.li1: Premium minimal design, balanced light/dark, breathing typography.
about.philosophy.li2: Lean stack: vanilla when possible, framework when it pays off.
about.philosophy.li3: Translation is engineering + LQA: authorized unofficial mods, glossaries, zero leaks and respect for devs.
